source.document: KODAK PROFESSIONAL TRI-X 320 and 400 Films — Technical Data F-4017 (February 2016)
source.process: KODAK PROFESSIONAL D-76, large tank, ~8 minutes at 20°C, agitation at 1-minute intervals (near the published CI 0.56 starting recommendation; small-tank D-76 stock is 6¾ min at 20°C)
source.digitization_notes: Approximate digitization of the published 400TX / 35 mm D–logE characteristic curve for D-76 large-tank ~8 min (F-4017 p.8). Absolute log exposure (lux-seconds, bar notation) remapped onto the project's relative log-exposure axis (rel ≈ kodak_logE + 4.0). Longer softer toe than HP5, mid-curve average gradient ~0.56–0.60 matching the datasheet CI target, open highlight scale into ~2.2 D. Diffuse rms granularity listed as 17 (fine); grain_scale set slightly above HP5 for classic Tri-X texture. Re-digitize from a high-res plot for production calibration.
